target.statement: FMC-EM achieves Balance = 0.481 and Cost = 12715 on the Adult dataset (fair clustering, K clusters, isotropic GMM, L2-normalized continuous features)
target.dataset: UCI Adult (32,561 samples, continuous features only)

compute.basis: No code released, so the FMC-EM algorithm (Algorithms 1-2, gradient formulas in appendix) must be reimplemented from scratch; Adult is small (~32k x 5 continuous features) and CPU-friendly, but reproducing the exact Balance/Cost cell requires matching hyperparameters (T=200, R=10, gamma=1e-2, lambda tuning, K-means init, 5 random inits) and the Pareto-front protocol.
